mapper.sql: SELECT c.id::text AS cycleId, c.year AS year, c.name AS name, c.status_code AS statusCode, (c.status_code = 201) AS editable, COUNT(l.id)::int AS levelCount FROM kpi_cycles c LEFT JOIN performance_rating_levels l ON l.cycle_id = c.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: GROUP BY c.id, c.year, c.name, c.status_code ORDER BY c.year DESC
AND c.year = #{year} GROUP BY c.id, c.year, c.name, c.status_code
AND c.id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler} GROUP BY c.id, c.year, c.name, c.status_code

SELECT id::text AS id, cycle_id::text AS cycleId, sort_order AS sortOrder, level_code AS levelCode, label AS label, min_score AS minScore, max_score AS maxScore, pitch AS pitch, color_hex AS colorHex, is_top_tier AS topTier FROM performance_rating_levels WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order ASC, level_code ASC

SELECT l.id::text AS id, l.cycle_id::text AS cycleId, l.sort_order AS sortOrder, l.level_code AS levelCode, l.label AS label, l.min_score AS minScore, l.max_score AS maxScore, l.pitch AS pitch, l.color_hex AS colorHex, l.is_top_tier AS topTier FROM performance_rating_levels l INNER JOIN kpi_cycles c ON c.id = l.cycle_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.year = #{year} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY l.sort_order ASC, l.level_code ASC
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM performance_rating_levels WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler} AND deleted_at IS NULL
